query:
UPDATE grocery_item_store_info SET
                    version = v.version,
                    updated_at = $4,
                    updated_by_client = $5,
                    sync_state = 'SYNCED'
                FROM UNNEST($1::text[], $2::text[], $3::int4[]) AS v(item_id, store_id, version)
                WHERE grocery_item_store_info."groceryItemId" = v.item_id
                  AND grocery_item_store_info."storeId" = v.store_id
